method: Direct visual reading of all40 source discovery sheets/875 native frames and all10 native candidate-bank sheets/190 first-middle-last/outside roles (154 unique full1080 frames). No whole-film/60:40/caption-cue approval follows from these research images.

observedActions: 174–191s: character approaches the large tree figure, dialogue and green effects; no exact prerequisite, completed unlock or numerical power increase inferred.
192–222s: winter base with distinct ranch animals and structures, camera/characters moving; separate mere pans/idle state from interaction.
234–251s and258–261s: ranch-area activities and changed seasonal base. Some shots overlap the other ranch preview; compare visually and do not repeat the same action under another source ID.
279–282s: structure connection UI and Stone Mine/Refinery information. Static catalogue reading is insufficient actual-action evidence by itself.

299–332s,335–344s and347–392s: short real combat/environment interaction and dialogue cuts. Retain only meaningful action matched to an actual claim; do not treat ordinary fighting as proof of an earned reward.
excluded: Idle or merely scenic shots without a concept connection
sources.decision: Hold as a secondary candidate bank; extensive non-game footage and brief action montage make it unsuitable as the sole source. No final intervals approved.

observedActions: 17–20s: animal-type UI, animal/name presentation; inspect selection transition and source continuity before counting interactive UI.
21–34s: animal interaction/collection animations near cow and sheep. Describe visible product icons/animations only after close boundary review.
38–43s: animal area with80/5 cost overlay and Feed Grass UI. This establishes a displayed resource requirement candidate, not the designer's actual development budget.
44–47s and55–62s: mounted animal movement and interaction. Do not infer acquisition prerequisites or equal performance across animal variants.
67–73s: animal shelter and interacting character pair, useful only with an explicit production/animation observation.
sources.decision: Potential animal-resource/capability/asset example; short edited shots require native boundaries and duplicate-shot checks. No final intervals approved.

observedActions: 32–43s: actual two-character local co-op combat. A newly supplied mode/character feature is not proof of a player-earned unlock.
44–47s: fleece/temple, building and fishing snippets with embedded promotional feature labels. No cosmetic-only or balance-equality assertion about fleece.
51–52s: actual dice-board minigame shot, very brief; insufficient alone to support an extended reward explanation.
61–64s: character/temple transformation and dialogue snippets, acquisition requirements not shown.
excluded: Mating/sexual-context snippets unrelated to the educational question
sources.decision: Keep only as a secondary feature candidate. Its gameplay labels at the bottom may collide with fixed narration captions and shots are short; prefer cleaner relevant material. No final intervals approved.

observedActions: 104–110s: player movement and nearby pick-up interaction; then117–119s resource icons/text. Source materials rather than a claim about effort motivation.
113–121s: actual elemental combat effects; numerical damage is visible but different shots are not a controlled before/after comparison.
125–130s: equipment/recipe selection, Life/Repair/Utility bullets, descriptions and cost fields; rapid cuts require native large-frame reading. Do not call every ammunition type a damage upgrade.
140–151s: placement/expansion of crafting station, mirror/desk/Arcana Bank/research-station structures. In-game resource costs differ from art/QA development costs.
155–175s: map reveal/expansion, battles and returning through a portal; no precise unlock condition inferred.
sources.decision: Strong recipe/capability candidate but only the later portion is actual gameplay and useful actions are brief. Obtain the publisher's targeted Ammo Craftwork/Exploring/Co-op videos rather than stretching this preview. No final intervals approved.

sources.title: Wizard with a Gun | Gunmancer's Diary: Ammo Craftwork | Available October 17
observedActions: 7–12s: enemy freeze and a separate projectile/shatter encounter. Separate source edits are not a controlled damage comparison.

13–28s: station, Frost research, enemy-material pickup, cobalt/iron resources, ammo description, furnace processing and powder selection. Exact readable prerequisites still need large-frame verification.
29–34s: freeze/shatter effects in combat.35–38s and54–61s: movement/ground effects and gap crossing, offering a capability example distinct from numerical damage.
39–53s: combat/material pickup, composter and Teleport/Ground research and ammo changes. Research and crafting are distinct visible steps.
62–82s: water, electric and ice-related combat, material pickup and Lightning research/upgrade selection. Combinations motivate our proposed testing checklist; no measured balance defect claimed.
83–89s: further elemental combat/crossing montage; stop before the logo transition.
excluded: Unrelated waiting or static extended menu time
sources.decision: Useful primary action source. Embedded recipe panels do not become our narration; review every retained cut and the fixed-caption strip. Logo frames at the old90s candidate end must be trimmed.

sources.title: Wizard with a Gun | Gunmancer's Diary: Exploring the Shatter
observedActions: 18–25s and35–37s: player/enemy movement, attack and dodging; these are context for our independent questions, not earned-reward evidence.
40–42s: Weak Healing Potion is Completed; Medium Healing Potion is selected, Research changes to Completed. The actual branch transition is a strong prerequisite candidate.
48–50s: movement near the tower mechanism; no exact unlock or roll-back condition inferred.
55–60s and65–72s: different enemies and elemental effects; keep only shots connected to a concrete asset/test requirement.
78–81s: combat around overlapping elemental hazards.
excluded: Large area title overlays dominating shots
sources.decision: Supplementary branch/requirements and action/test context. Native boundary reading rejected a dialogue tail in21–26s and a tower-title tail in40–43s.

sources.title: Wizard with a Gun | Four-Player Co-Op + More | Out Now
observedActions: 75–83s and87–97s: several actual player characters use attacks in the same game space; material pickups appear.
98–104s: brief enemy action, then camera/group movement; split useful action from idle views.
121–131s: tower stations and General Library interaction, but development-build telemetry and name overlays require exclusion/framing review.
150–152s: combat/pickup, followed by a large date label.155–163s: further co-op elemental combat before the end card.
excluded: All office/interview footage and real faces
Paused development-build screens, menus for numerical difficulty settings and debug-state filler
Developer-name/date/logo overlays where they interfere with the selected action
Claims that co-op itself is an earned reward or a competitive-balance test
sources.decision: Supplemental combination/testing context. Old84/105/132/164s candidate ends enter non-game or logo frames; exact revised ends are required. Station/library and short scenic shots are held rather than assumed quota.

ranch-06 contains a non-game animated transition and unrelated combat; reject the whole seven-second proposal rather than count it as ranch gameplay.

ammo-15 reaches a logo before90s; trim it.
shatter-02 reaches a dialogue/cut at25.983s; trim.

coop-01 ends in an office/interview before84s; coop-03 ends in an office before105s.

nextAction: Trim/reject native conflicts, obtain extra relevant actual action without looping/padding, review revised boundary frames and readable requirement UI, then record the independent whole-video overview and claim/shot plan before narration.
